create_ndarray_field: create an NDArrayField instance with a numpy dtype and shape tuple for fixed-size multi-dimensional matrices
deserialize_ndarray_from_binary: deserialize an NDArrayField from binary data using the from_binary static method to reconstruct dtype and shape
serialize_ndarray_to_binary: serialize an NDArrayField to binary format using the to_binary method for storage or transmission
